model.name: A QA-Review row carries the served version its evidence was measured on — no version = not accept-ready, behind = stale-pending-remeasure
model.description: PO order 2026-09-09 (confirm-or-mint): a QA-Review row must carry THE SERVED VERSION its evidence was measured on. A QA row's evidence is a stored, authoritative-looking artifact with NOTHING keeping it TRUE against the currently-served build = a truth-decay specimen (extends R37.25). NO version => NOT accept-ready (it cannot be a Tron-accept candidate). A version BEHIND the served build => auto-flagged STALE-PENDING-REMEASURE (the evidence decayed; re-measure on the served version before accept). MEASURED: 77 QA rows were carried as 'finished, awaiting Tron' with NO current evidence — 68 cite no version at all, 9 cite a stale version. The accept queue is 24, not 101.

discoverySource.note: 77 QA rows carried finished-awaiting-Tron with NO current evidence (68 no version, 9 stale); accept queue is 24 not 101. A QA row's evidence is a truth-decay specimen (extends R37.25).

model.crossRefNote: NEW SPECIMEN of the R37.25 truth-decay family (a stored authoritative QA-evidence artifact with nothing keeping it fresh vs the served build) — extends R37.25 (the freshness meta-invariant already gates it; this adds the QA-evidence class + the 77-row audit + auto-flag). Feeds R40.10 (Tron renders his QA verdict) = only fresh-evidence rows reach his accept surface. Same never-make-the-customer-the-tester law (he must not accept a row on decayed evidence).

acceptanceCriteria.text: Every QA-Review row carries the SERVED VERSION its evidence was measured on (a served-version field on the row/task). The version is machine-readable + queryable.
